title: Functions Stopping Working
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on vehicle, app, and infotainment functions suddenly stopping or quitting, with many fragments too brief or context-limited to determine sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: One positive review is present, but its example describes the car suddenly stopping with a severe jerk, so the positive assignment is not well explained by the fragment alone.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe app failures, maps and cruise control stopping, driver-assistance features failing after an update, dashboard functions dropping out, and a vehicle shutting down while driving.

mixed.summary: The mixed review praises neither outcome clearly and instead combines a major dashboard failure with concern about safety and loss of essential functions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention working or stopped functions without enough context to confirm whether they reflect a complaint, comparison, or incidental remark.

limitations: This cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including vehicle shutdowns, dashboard and lighting issues, app problems, maps, and driver-assistance features.
Many undetermined fragments are too short or lack surrounding context, which limits confidence in interpreting the underlying issue or sentiment.
One fragment labeled positive contains negative-sounding wording, so the sample provides insufficient context to explain that sentiment assignment.
